purpose: Unblock the already authorized PC-CROP control-host cutover for #3785 by distinguishing real concurrent production work from stale queued workflow records that are older than one hour and have zero materialized jobs.
requiredInvariants: Every in-progress production, release, deploy, REG.RU, cutover, activation or rolling workflow remains a hard blocker.
Every matching queued run newer than one hour remains a hard blocker even when GitHub has not materialized its jobs.
A queued matching run may be ignored only when it is older than one hour and the GitHub Actions jobs API independently returns exactly zero jobs.
Queued runs with one or more materialized jobs remain hard blockers regardless of age.
The current cutover run excludes only itself and keeps all existing exact-main, DNS, pinned SSH, Compose, backup, rollback and 10-round live acceptance guards.
This queue-classification change performs no production mutation by itself and does not cancel, delete or alter historical workflow records.
GO remains forbidden until First Customer and all 9 of 9 role journeys pass.
acceptance: The five observed August 19 queue ghosts qualify only because each is more than one hour old and has zero jobs.
A real recent or materialized concurrent production run still stops the cutover before DNS, SSH or production mutation.
Workflow syntax and exact-head security gates pass before merge.
Successful merge may retry the guarded cutover; any preflight failure remains no-mutation and any later failure retains automatic rollback.
